## Scope

## Verification

<!-- Evidence, not claims. See docs/principles/03-verification.md -->

- **Ran:** `<command>` → <result>
- **Observed:** <what was done in the running app> → <what happened>
- **Bug repro (if fix):** before → <broken>, after → <fixed>
- **Test proves the change:** <which test fails without this change>
- **Not verified:** <what couldn't be checked, and why, or "nothing">

## Risk & rollback

- **Risk:** low / medium / high. <What could break?>
- **Rollback:** revert this PR / feature flag `<name>` / other: <...>
